item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In April 2023, the first two volumes of Xi Jinping's selected works were published by the People's Publishing House and scheduled for nationwide distribution; compiled by the Party Literature Editing Committee, they contain 146 items from November 2012 to October 2022 and were described as an authoritative resource for studying and implementing Xi Jinping Thought.","notes":["The excerpt says the People's Publishing House published the books; the Party Literature Editing Committee compiled them.","The excerpt says distribution would begin nationwide, not that the committee ordered it."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Official 2023 education-finance statistics reported total national education expenditure of 64,595.04 hundred-million yuan, up 5.33% year-on-year; state fiscal education expenditure was 50,439.47 hundred-million yuan, up 4.06%, and state fiscal education expenditure equaled 4.00% of GDP.","notes":["The excerpt reports amounts in 亿元 (hundred-million yuan), not billions of yuan; the proposed quantities are ten times too high when expressed as billions."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In January-February 2023, the Cyberspace Administration launched a one-month Spring Festival campaign against online gambling, fraud, harmful content, bullying, addiction, misinformation, and problems involving the protection and monetization of minors; it directed local authorities and platforms to inspect priority channels, establish work teams, strengthen content review, and investigate and punish violating websites, accounts, and MCN organizations, including through closures where specified.","notes":["The excerpt announces and directs the campaign; it does not establish that it was completed or report results.","It calls for investigating and punishing violators and specifies closure measures in some cases, but does not support saying all listed entities were punished or closed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In November-December 2023, the Cyberspace Administration launched a nationwide one-month campaign against online hostility, targeting doxxing, coordinated abuse, fabricated attacks, group stigmatization, violent livestream behavior, malicious reporting, abusive slang, and extreme emotional incitement; it ordered account and group closures, feature restrictions, platform rectification, penalties, and weekly publication of typical cases by key platforms.","notes":["The excerpt requires key platforms to publish typical cases weekly, not all platforms generally."]}]}
